roots.title: Integer and Mixed-Integer Optimization
roots.top_down_role: Adaptive-depth structural navigation for Integer and Mixed-Integer Optimization.

children.title: Integer-Variable Modeling Architecture
children.top_down_role: Modeling architectures, formulation families, representation choices, quality criteria, structural regimes, and modeling failures for integer and mixed-integer optimization; detailed solution theory belongs to linked chapters.

children.title: Logic-Disjunction Formulation Synthesis
children.top_down_role: Logical structure, algebraic encodings, unions of feasible sets, disjunctive convexification, formulation comparisons, and solver-facing mechanisms; general polyhedral theory, generic cutting-plane algorithms, and application-specific models remain cross-linked.

children.title: Formulation Strength Extension Theory
children.top_down_role: Formulation strength, ideality, extended representations, disjunctive hull constructions, on-off convexification, and their computational tradeoffs; polyhedral foundations and complete solution algorithms remain in linked chapters.

children.title: Factorable Linearization Calculus
children.top_down_role: Exact and relaxation-based reformulations of products, polynomial terms, on-off nonlinearities, and piecewise-linear functions, together with their geometry, encoding choices, strength comparisons, implementation interfaces, and failure boundaries.

children.title: Symmetry in Integer Models
children.top_down_role: Symmetry structures, representative-selection geometry, symmetry handling formulations, dynamic search methods, solver integration, applicability regimes, and failure boundaries in integer and mixed-integer models.

children.title: Integer-Polyhedral Systems Theory
children.top_down_role: Geometric, algebraic, dual, and closure-based structures governing integer and mixed-integer polyhedra; solution algorithms and application-specific polytope theories remain outside this chapter.

children.title: Valid-Inequality Cutting-Plane Theory
children.top_down_role: Navigation for linear valid inequalities and cutting-plane theory in integer and mixed-integer optimization, from validity and generation through closures, algorithms, computational interfaces, and limitations.

children.title: Separation Cut-Management Interface
children.top_down_role: Navigation for finding violated inequalities, organizing separator families, managing generated cuts, and integrating separation into integer-optimization solvers.

children.title: Branching Search Bounds
children.top_down_role: Exact and certifying tree-search architectures for discrete and global optimization, from search-space organization through computational and complexity boundaries.

children.title: Integrated Branching-Cutting Algorithms
children.top_down_role: Algorithmic integration of cutting planes with enumerative search for integer and mixed-integer optimization; polyhedral derivations, standalone branching theory, decomposition, and nonlinear global optimization remain cross-linked.

children.title: Structured MIP Decomposition Algorithm Family
children.top_down_role: Navigation for projection, inverse-projection, price-based, and Lagrangian decomposition methods used to bound or solve structured mixed-integer programs; general branching, cutting-plane, stochastic-programming, nonlinear-duality, and solver-architecture theory remain cross-linked.

children.title: Integer-Programming Dynamic Programs
children.top_down_role: Exact and bounded-state dynamic-programming structures used to solve integer programs or their pricing subproblems; general dynamic programming, decomposition theory, and unrelated integer-programming machinery remain outside this container.

children.title: Practical MIP Solver Mechanisms
children.top_down_role: Operational mechanisms that transform, process, diagnose, extend, and validate practical mixed-integer optimization solves; formulation theory, cutting-plane theory, branching theory, and decomposition theory remain in their owning chapters.

children.title: Mixed-Integer Quadratic-Nonlinear Optimization
children.top_down_role: Navigation for mixed-integer quadratic, quadratically constrained, convex nonlinear, and globally treated nonconvex nonlinear optimization, emphasizing formulations, relaxations, certificates, and solver interfaces.

children.title: Binary Optimization
children.top_down_role: Binary decision models, their equivalent representations, canonical problem families, strengthening theory, specialized relaxations, search mechanisms, certificates, and binary-specific failure regimes.

children.title: Integer Programming Complexity-Algorithmics Synthesis
children.top_down_role: Complexity classifications, tractable structural regimes, geometry-of-numbers algorithms, lattice-point enumeration, rational generating functions, and proof certificates for linear integer and mixed-integer optimization.
